objectName: CineGlide Pro 3-Axis Motorized Camera Slider & Pan/Tilt Head
designAdjustments: Round 1 -> Designer Revision 1: Calibrated PRT-04 (Gantry Carriage Deck) eccentric spacer bores to 7.20mm ID and fixed M5 wheel axle bores to 5.05mm ID.
Round 1 -> Designer Revision 1: Increased PRT-01 & PRT-02 2020 extrusion socket clearance to 20.25×20.25mm so anodized rails slide in without elephant-foot binding.
Round 1 -> Designer Revision 1: Reinforced PRT-07 (Tilt U-Yoke) thickness to 6.0mm (4.0mm perimeters) to support 3.5kg DSLR/mirrorless payloads.

rounds.summary: Round 1 DFM audit flagged 2 precision linear-motion tolerances (2020 extrusion socket fit on PRT-01/02 and 7.2mm eccentric nut bore on PRT-04). Looping fixes back to Designer.
fixesApplied: PRT-01 / PRT-02: 2020 rail socket pocket widened by +0.25mm with 0.8mm corner relief dogbones
PRT-04 (gantry-carriage-plate): eccentric wheel bores set to 7.20mm ID; thickness increased to 14mm

issues.problem: Standard 6mm OpenBuilds eccentric spacers require a 7.15–7.20mm bore on one side of the carriage and 5.05mm on the fixed side.
issues.finding: Asymmetric 5.05mm / 7.20mm wheel bore pair needed for Delrin wheel preload.
issues.fix: Set front wheel bores to 5.05mm (r=2.53) and rear eccentric bores to 7.20mm (r=3.60).
issues.fixApplied: Updated PRT-04 holes array with r=2.6mm fixed and r=3.6mm eccentric bores.

rounds.summary: Round 2 verification passed (98/100): All 9 printed parts (12 items) fit onto 2 Bambu Lab A1 plates, meet >=3.5–4.0mm structural wall thickness, and include verified V-slot and 6808 bearing tolerances.
fixesApplied: Verified all Round 1 DFM fixes in design.json.
